parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'project_id', p.id,
  'project_name', p.name,
  'project_type', p.project_type,
  'current_phase', p.current_phase,
  'plan', (SELECT json_build_object('id', pp.id, 'phases', pp.phases, 'total_duration_days', pp.total_duration_days, 'milestones', pp.milestones) FROM project_plans pp WHERE pp.project_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC LIMIT 1),
  'last_design', (SELECT json_build_object('title', d.title, 'description', d.description, 'rooms_layout', d.rooms_layout) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1),
  'recent_reports', (SELECT count(*) FROM site_reports sr WHERE sr.project_id = p.id AND sr.reported_at > now() - INTERVAL '14 days')
) AS context
FROM projects p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid;
